postThemes: TV too complex / remote failure without wifi
locked-down phone with texts/camera/calendar but strong scam blocking
simple TV with no smart menus
one-button AM radio / church service listening
Echo Show setup friction and account model

ideas.title: Big-button TV companion
ideas.problem: Caregivers need power/volume/one-channel only; smart TV menus and PVRs constantly break usability
ideas.fit: Software+IR/HDMI-CEC box or Fire TV sidecar app with 3-button physical remote enclosure

ideas.title: Auto-answer caregiver call mode
ideas.problem: LO cannot swipe/answer or manage volume; family needs reliable speakerphone reach-out
ideas.fit: Android app/MDM profile or dedicated cheap phone mode: auto-answer allowlisted contacts at max speaker volume

ideas.title: Scam-safe senior phone launcher
ideas.problem: Standard phones expose search/ads/gmail leading to scams; need texts/camera/calendar/calls with hard allowlists
ideas.fit: Custom Android launcher + DNS/firewall + contact/site allowlist; optional kiosk tablet/phone image

ideas.title: One-function church radio box
ideas.problem: Multi-function CD/radio combos are too hard; need ultra-simple AM/station playback that survives decline
ideas.fit: 3D-printed one-big-button radio enclosure around ESP/Pi/stream module or pre-tuned AM radio

ideas.title: Toilet splash guard + raised seat kit research
ideas.problem: Raised seat + handles still allow urine between seat and bowl/floor
ideas.fit: Possibly 3D-printed splash guard prototype, but hygiene/materials constraints; lower priority vs software aids

notes: Retargeted daily watch from previous dementia support group to this tech/aids group. George already posted seeking unmet tech needs; strong reply cluster around phones/TV simplicity.
